maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Ubank help centre - What's the minimum deposit or equity I need for a Ubank home loan?
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: 'If you're getting an owner occupied home loan repaying principal and interest (P&I), you'll need to have a deposit that's at least 10% of your property value when purchasing or at least 15% equity when refinancing.' Interest-only loans require at least 20% deposit/equity (max 80% LVR). Live page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: Ubank help centre - What's the minimum deposit or equity I need for a Ubank home loan?
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: 'If you're getting an investment loan repaying P&I, you'll need to have a deposit that's at least 10% of your property value when purchasing or at least 20% equity when refinancing.' Live page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLvrRefinancePct.sourceTitle: Ubank help centre - What's the minimum deposit or equity I need for a Ubank home loan?
maxLvrRefinancePct.note: Owner occupied P&I refinance requires at least 15% equity (85% LVR); investment P&I refinance requires at least 20% equity (80% LVR). Live page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Ubank - Avoid LMI on home loans (No LMI with up to 90% LVR)
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: 'With Ubank, you can apply for an owner occupied or investment home loan repaying principal and interest (P&I) without paying LMI even if you have a deposit as low as 10% (for purchases) or for owner occupied home loans repaying P&I if you have equity as low as 15% (if refinancing).' Live page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

notes.value: 'Owner occupied loans with a loan to value ratio (LVR) over 85%, and Investment loans with an LVR over 80%, are for new purchases only. Each application is limited to up to $2,000,000 when the LVR is over 85%, subject to credit criteria.'

minLoanAmount.note: 'Ubank offers home loans between $80,000 and $5,000,000.' Live page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Ubank help centre - How much can I borrow from Ubank?
maxLoanAmount.note: 'Ubank offers home loans between $80,000 and $5,000,000. Each application is limited to up to $2,000,000 when the loan to value ratio (LVR) is over 85%.' Live page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

offsetAvailable.sourceTitle: Ubank - Avoid LMI on home loans (No LMI with up to 90% LVR)
offsetAvailable.note: Offset accounts are available on the Flex variable and Flex fixed loans ($250 p.a. annual fee); the Neat variable loan has no offset and no annual fee. Live page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: Ubank - Avoid LMI on home loans (No LMI with up to 90% LVR)
redrawAvailable.note: Redraw available on Neat and Flex (up to $20K during a fixed term). Live page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

Minimum age 18.

gaps: No public Ubank assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, credit card assessment rate or HEM basis - broker.ubank.com.au requires a login.
No published employment tenure minimums, probation policy, income shading percentages or evidence requirements per income type.
No published credit-history thresholds (defaults, arrears, bankruptcy), security/postcode restrictions, minimum unit size or high-density policy.
Maximum loan term and interest-only maximum terms are not published.
Ubank's public site is served behind a WAF that blocks plain HTTP clients; the pages were read in a browser.
